analysis:
Integration of the prior passes. The supplied PR changes are documentation and a submodule pointer. The documentation covers changelog.d/fused-causal-prefill-attention.md (lines 1-5), a new row at docs/architecture/inference.md head line 671, and docs/reference/configuration.md (date at line 3, new env-var row at about line 313). The pointer moves libs/mlx-swift-lm from 19634dd8 to fd17d026. The docs describe a performance change: eligible full-attention prompt chunks use one fused .causal SDPA call instead of 128-query blocks. It excludes window, softcap, vision-span, bidirectional and live packed paged KV paths. DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL=0 is a kill switch, read once per process and not forwarded to LaunchAgents, so it adds no operator-controlled launchd surface.

Nothing documented touches key custody, attestation, the WebSocket contract (TB-002), App Attest authorization (TB-011), or prefix-cache storage, scope, HMAC lookup naming, TTL or crypto (T-041). The behavior stays inside the in-process engine (TB-007). It is a numerical and performance change with no new egress. Possible timing shifts fall under the already accepted SEC-035 oracle. Consumers and the coordinator cannot set the env var.

Unverified, because the submodule diff and the Swift implementation (AttentionV1.swift and PagedLayerCache.swift prefillAttend) are not in the supplied evidence: (1) whether the fused path preserves masking and cross-request isolation in paged KV, and whether it leaves KV or prefix-cache layout, block hashing and checkpoint contents intact (T-041, T-028); (2) whether the new env var is covered by DeadlineRuntimeEnvironment.permitsQualification; (3) memory-admission effects; (4) any other changes bundled in the submodule bump. These are recorded as coverage limits, not findings. The submodule pointer change warrants review of the actual submodule diff.
